details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:43 (mirror: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md; audit side .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:34-35; scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1200-1235) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `/audit-plans` relies on a bundle project's tracking issue naming all bundled plans, but the Step 5 preamble never requires each plan's repo-relative path in the project summary, and `build_tracking_issue_body` writes only title, summary, waves and edges.
  WHY: Later audits may miss bundle members 2-3, so they are re-recommended and their files are left out of the in-flight footprint (reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:38-41 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No rule skips a candidate whose declared prerequisite is unshipped and is neither the anchor nor a bundle member.
  WHY: The bundle can dispatch a dependent plan whose prerequisite code does not exist or ships in another project, and the DAG cannot order against it (reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:36-39 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The conflict screen at line 36 lets shared but independent files pass, while the "Related" bullet at line 39 treats overlapping touched files as relatedness.
  WHY: Unrelated plans that share only an incidental file can be bundled, using up the caps. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR, the other three NIT; the highest is used.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:8,74 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The cap counts "only the phases still missing" for a partially-implemented plan, but this command has no step that determines which phases have shipped.
  WHY: Direct invocation applies the cap inconsistently. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR, the others NIT; the highest is used.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:8 (also line 74) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Bundle." bullet does not require the 2-3 named paths to resolve to distinct plans.
  WHY: A repeated path takes a bundle slot or shrinks the bundle below two distinct plans (reviewers rated it NIT).
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:41 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "stop and ask" rule covers only unreachable plans, not transient API errors (network/auth/unavailable) on a bundle member's PR lookup or fetch.
  WHY: A bundle can be dispatched with an unverified member whose branch or PR is wrong (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The in-flight conflict gate now also reads every plan a bundle project's tracking issue names (review fix)."
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md Step 5 preamble bullet (~line 43) and its template mirror; alternatively `build_tracking_issue_body` in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The audit side reads the plans a tracking issue names, but no hunk makes the tracking issue name them, `build_tracking_issue_body` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1200-1235) never writes `project_description`, and the Bundles preamble does not require plan paths in the project summary.
- requirement: "Phases count toward the cap the same way `/audit-plans` counts them (review fix)" and the changelog row "Phases per bundle, summed across plans | at most 8"
  expected_change_site: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py, `test_implement_plan_ai_dispatches_a_bundle_once` (lines 105-112/114)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The test pins neither "a plan with no phase split counts as 1" nor "a partially-implemented plan counts only the phases still missing", though both phrases are present in both copies of implement-plan-ai.md.
- requirement: "Phases count toward the cap the same way `/audit-plans` counts them," including counting only missing phases for a partially implemented plan
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md, bundle resolution and phase-counting procedure
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Line 8 states how to count phases for a partial plan, but Steps 1-8 do not require the repository-state verification that `/audit-plans` uses to identify missing phases.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:~43 (mirror: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md; audit side .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:34-35) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bundle preamble never asks the orchestrator to put each plan's repo-relative path in the project summary, and `build_tracking_issue_body` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1200-1235) never writes `project_description`.
  WHY: A later `/audit-plans` run may find only some of the bundled plans, so they can be re-recommended and their files are left out of the in-flight footprint.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:38-41 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No rule skips a candidate whose declared prerequisite is unshipped and is neither the anchor nor a member.
  WHY: The bundle can dispatch a dependent plan whose prerequisite code does not exist or is being built by another project.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:36,39 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Bare file overlap can be read as relatedness even though the conflict screen lets shared independent files pass.
  WHY: Independent plans sharing an incidental file can be bundled, using up the caps.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:8,74 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap counts only missing phases, but this command has no step that works out which phases are missing, and repeated paths in `$ARGUMENTS` have no rule.
  WHY: The cap is applied inconsistently, and a repeat can push a real member out of the 2-3 limit.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The in-flight conflict gate now also reads every plan a bundle project's tracking issue names (review fix)." | Expected change site: Step 5 preamble bullet in implement-plan-ai.md and its template mirror (~line 43), or `build_tracking_issue_body` | Evidence of absence: no hunk makes the tracking issue name the plans | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Phases count toward the cap the same way `/audit-plans` counts them (review fix)" and the changelog row "Phases per bundle, summed across plans | at most 8" | Expected change site: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py `test_implement_plan_ai_dispatches_a_bundle_once` (lines 105-112) | Evidence of absence: the two counting phrases are not asserted | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:36,39 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A plan that shares only an independent file with the anchor passes the conflict screen and is then treated as "Related" and bundled.
  WHY: An unrelated plan consumes a bundle slot and the "one bundle per project" promise is broken.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:39,41 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No rule requires a declared prerequisite to be shipped or in the bundle, and the line 41 carve-out does not catch it.
  WHY: The orchestrator can schedule a member's phases ahead of a prerequisite that has not shipped.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:8,43,74 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: This command has no step to check which phases have shipped, so the "phases still missing" count is whatever the operator estimates.
  WHY: The cap either fires when it should not or fails to fire, so the orchestrator's phase budget disagrees with reality.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:8 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Resolved plan paths are not deduplicated before the caps are applied.
  WHY: A repeated path can drop the distinct-plan count below 2 or take a real member's slot.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:41 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "stop and ask" rule covers only unreachable plans, not transient API errors on a member's PR lookup or fetch.
  WHY: A bundle can be dispatched with an unverified member.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The in-flight conflict gate now also reads every plan a bundle project's tracking issue names (review fix)." | Expected change site: implement-plan-ai.md line 43 together with `build_tracking_issue_body` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1200) | Evidence of absence: `build_tracking_issue_body` (lines 1200-1235) never writes `project_description` or the member plan paths, and the preamble does not require them in `project_summary` | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: the PR description's "5 new contract tests" and the changelog row "Phases per bundle, summed across plans | at most 8" | Expected change site: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py `test_implement_plan_ai_dispatches_a_bundle_once` (lines 105-114) | Evidence of absence: neither phase-counting phrase is asserted | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:39-41 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A candidate with an unshipped prerequisite outside the bundle can qualify through shared files.
  WHY: The bundle can include a plan whose absent prerequisite cannot be sequenced, leaving the dependent work blocked.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:36,39 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The conflict screen lets shared independent files pass, while relatedness treats any overlapping declared files as sufficient.
  WHY: Unrelated plans that share an independent file can be bundled.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:8 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 2-3 named paths are not required to resolve to distinct plans.
  WHY: A repeated path consumes a bundle slot and dispatches duplicate references as a multi-plan project.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The in-flight conflict gate now also reads every plan a bundle project's tracking issue names (review fix)." | Expected change site: implement-plan-ai.md "Step 5 — preamble", or the tracking-issue summary construction in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py | Evidence of absence: the preamble (implement-plan-ai.md:43-44) does not require every plan path in the project summary, and scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1207-1210 builds the issue body from `project_title` and `project_summary`, not `project_description` | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Phases count toward the cap the same way `/audit-plans` counts them," including counting only missing phases | Expected change site: implement-plan-ai.md bundle resolution and phase-counting procedure | Evidence of absence: Steps 1-8 do not require the repository-state verification `/audit-plans` uses to identify missing phases | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:34-35 (with implement-plan-ai.md:43-44 and scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1200-1235) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `build_tracking_issue_body` writes only project_title, project_summary, wave rows and dependency edges, and the Step 5 preamble never requires each bundled plan's path
